verdict.rationale: Brex's Global product page says it can pay reimbursements to and from local bank accounts, avoiding intercompany transactions, as part of its own platform (brex-docs-44). It also says budgets and spend limits can be managed in over 100 currencies (brex-docs-45), and that reimbursements are filed inside Brex (brex-docs-23). Together these support handling foreign-employee reimbursements without a separate international payments process. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that reimbursements pay out in the employee's local currency, the list of supported payout countries and currencies, API or detailed docs for international reimbursement payouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
